page.layout: One page of text. Full-width title block at the top, a dedication heading with salutation, then one paragraph opening with a woodcut initial. At the foot, a signature mark at centre and a catchword at right. No margin notes and no running head.

main_text.head: Illustr. & Præpotent. BELGICÆ Fœderatarum Provinciarum ORDINIBVS GENERALIBVS, Earundemq; Provinciarum GVBERNATORIBVS Illustrissimis ac Fidelissimis, Religionis Reformatæ, & Belgicæ Libertatis Assertoribus strenuissimis.
main_text.p: ILLVSTRISSIMI PRINCIPES ac Domini, Religionis verae in sinceritate ac pace conservationem non tantum ad muneris vestri cu-ram pertinere, sed etiam Reipublicae vestrae præci-puum esse στύλον[?] καὶ ἑδραίωμα, optimè Vos intelligere reipsa ostenditis. Conservari veram Religionem in sinceritate ac pace vix posse, in hac perversitatis

page.notes: The title block's first line is small italic. The initial I is a woodcut and is joined to the small capitals "LLVSTRISSIMI", so it reads ILLVSTRISSIMI. The Greek word after "esse" is printed as ςύλον/ƨύλον, with an unclear first letter, so it is marked [?]; the phrase appears to be from 1 Tim. 3:15. "Earundemq;" carries the printed q-with-stroke abbreviation. The catchword "huma-" is at the right below the last full line and keeps its hyphen. The paragraph ends at "perversitatis" because the catchword is not part of the text. No running head, since the page opens the dedication. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
